name: Biofilm
flavor: Scraped cyanobacterial mat. The free starter resource; the Devs spawn it everywhere.

name: Soft Tissue
flavor: Cnidarian flesh, minus the stinging parts. Handle with confidence you may not have earned.

name: Chitin
flavor: Mineralized plate cracked off a grazer. The armor meta, available as a crafting mat.

name: Apex Flesh
flavor: Tissue from something near the top of the ladder. You did not get this for free.

name: Plankton
flavor: The open water's baseline resource. Bottomless supply; the Devs pump it out constantly.

name: Calcite Lattice
flavor: Archaeocyathid reef skeleton — early biomineralization in structural form. Good for express costs that want tensile strength.

name: Lucent Flesh
flavor: Near-transparent tissue from a glass drifter. The stealth meta, rendered as a crafting mat.
